Southside Critical Mass

Chicago, IL · South Side · Social

Southside Critical Mass is a social group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls first Friday of the month at 6:15 pm from Nichols Park. About 18–22 miles, under 10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Southside Critical Mass group ride

The South Side's own Critical Mass, on the first Friday instead of the last. Listed in the Chicago Group Rides directory; check the Facebook page for each month's start point.
